blocks.p: The *Skills* tab of the *Character* window lists every skill by group: *Combat - Firearms*, *Combat - Melee*, *Crafting*, *Farming*, *Physical* and *Survival*. Figure 16-1 shows the tab.

marks.text: The level at the left, ten cells at the right.
A long name is cut short.

sticky.text: Every skill: its level and its bar.

blocks.p: Each row of the tab gives one skill. Its parts are listed in Table 16-1. Point at a skill and the top of the window gives its name, its level and its experience: *Long Blade - Lv.0 - 0/75*.

table.label: Table 16-1
table.title: The parts of a skill row
head: Part
What it shows
rows: The number at the left, from 0 to 10.
The skill. A long name is cut short to fit.
Ten cells, one for each level.
A tag such as *+125% XP*: the skill learns faster.

blocks.p: Below the skills, *Training Materials* lists the skill books, one cell for each volume, colored by the key above the list: *Read*, *Reading*, *Collected* or *Not found*.
A boost comes from your profession and your traits. The *Identity* tab lists your traits, positive and negative, as Figure 16-2 shows. Chapter 2 describes the tab.
